subject: english
question: How was Indian cuisine able to influence other cuisines across the world?

options.text: Indians introduced the idea of coconut oil to people across the globe
Spices were bought from India and traded around Europe and Asia
Indians living across the globe prepared Indian food for locals
Indians introduced chilly food to the world

solution:
The correct answer is "**Spices were bought from India and traded around Europe and Asia.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We are required to select a reason that led to the spread of Indian cuisines around the world.
 
• Now, refer to the following lines from the passage:
 
 
• Line 2 of paragraph 2: Indian cuisine has shaped the history of international relations; **the spice trade between India and Europe** was the primary catalyst for Europe’s Age of Discovery.
 
• Line 3 of paragraph 2: **Spices were bought from India and traded around Europe and Asia.**
 
 
 
• **​**From the highlighted part in the above lines, it can be concluded that option 1, 3 and 4 can be eliminated.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
